name: FM Bass
description: Two-operator FM bass: a sine whose phase is bent by a second sine, bright where it is struck and rounder as the bend falls away, from a soft thump through a hollow knock to a growl.

params.name: Ratio
params.description: Pitch of the bending sine against the note, which sets the overtones. 1 is full and round, 2 and 4 hollow, 3, 5 and 7 wooden to glassy, and 1/2 adds an octave below.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the note is bent when it is struck, which is how bright and hard its start is. At zero the bass is a pure sine. Harder playing bends further.

params.name: Bite
params.description: How long the brightness of the strike takes to fall away. Short is a click or a knock on the front of the note; long is a slow darkening.

params.name: Body
params.description: How much of the brightness stays once the strike has passed. At zero the note settles to a pure round tone; at full it stays as bright as it was struck.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: Feeds the bending sine back into itself, which adds an edge: a little rasp at first, a buzzing growl at the top.

params.name: Sub
params.description: Level of a pure tone one octave below the note, for weight under a thin or hollow sound.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long a held note takes to die away, from a short thump to a fall of many seconds. At the very top the note holds for as long as the key is down.

params.name: Release
params.description: How quickly the note fades once the key is let go. A note never rings longer after the key than it would have while held.

params.name: Glide
params.description: Time the pitch takes to slide to a new key pressed while another is still held. Keys played apart start on pitch.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it catches peaks at high settings.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Two-operator phase modulation in outline: a sine carrier at the key, a sine modulator at a whole-number ratio (or half) with feedback through the mean of its last two outputs, an index that falls from Depth to Body times Depth after each strike, and a sine an octave down. Choices of this device, not measurements of any instrument: an index of Depth squared times 8 radians, a softest key that bends 0.4 of the hardest, a bend that covers 99 % of its fall in Bite, feedback up to one radian, a 2 ms strike, Release that only shortens Decay, a 2 Hz DC blocker, four times oversampling through two decimators of its own (the last stops at half the sample rate), a sine table read by a whole-number phase, and an index cap fitted to this voice's own measured fold-back. Tuned by measurement only: nobody has listened to it.
